Vendored browser assets in this directory are loaded as same-origin public files.

`openarm-connect-C3lO3qk6.js` is copied from the public Hugging Face Space
`haixuantao/openarm`, asset `assets/connect-C3lO3qk6.js`, because the Hugging
Face raw file is served as text and cannot be imported as an ES module by the
browser. App code should consume it only through the OpenArm live observe client.
